comment: Default input bindings, registered at startup; every action is rebindable in Settings > Controls (saved to user://keybinds.cfg over these). Terraria habits: left click uses, right click interacts, 1-0 and the mouse wheel (down: next slot) pick the hotbar slot, Q throws the held item, M opens the map, Enter shows the chat history, Tab/I the inventory, which you can walk, jump, grapple and fight with open. Kept for a 3D game: E interacts, F grapples (Terraria's E), Ctrl drops through platforms (Terraria's S), Shift sprints. Quick heal/mana/buff and smart cursor come later (P3-33, P2-29).
